node.title: Re: hey how to recursively access the directroies to search for a keyword and print its file name and the keyword line?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Welcome to the Monastery, [harishnv]. I can't tell if your post was always empty or if you've removed its contents, but either way, please see [id://174051] for some guidelines on how to best ask questions. Normally, it'd be good if you include the code you have tried, how you expect it to behave, what is going wrong with it including exact error messages, and any other information so that we can reproduce the situation on our end, for example sample input and the expected output for that input. A question consisting of just the title is normally not enough information to go on. Please see [id://17557] for how to edit your node to include more information.

hey how to recursively access the directroies to search for a keyword and print its file name and the keyword line?

For recursively finding files, you could use the core module [doc://File::Find], or with a nicer interface [mod://File::Find::Rule]. Then, for each file, you could open it, read it line-by-line, use a regular expression to find matches, and get the current line number from the special variable [doc://$.|$.]. Everything you need for that is explained in [doc://perlintro], pay particular attention to the description of foreach (for looping over a list of files) and the sections "Files and I/O" and "Regular expressions".
